record_type_quote: Following this thrust in psychology in conducting replication research (e.g., IJzerman, Brandt, & van Wolferen, 2013; Pashler & Waagenmakers, 2012), in this paper, we seek to replicate the findings of the research entitled “Oral approach–avoidance: Affective consequences of muscular articulation dynamics” by Topolinski and colleagues (2014).
